evidence.detail: rotation_cards_api passes q to card_search_where which does card-name/attribute search only — no rotation-specific predicates
The _rotation table has hits, hits_needed, status (Legal/Undecided/Not Legal) columns that are not exposed as search syntax
card_search_where is the only search mechanism wired into the rotation endpoint; no rotation-specific keyword parsing exists

triage.notes: Implementation requires designing the keyword syntax (e.g. hits:>10, status:legal), adding a rotation-specific query preprocessor in clauses.py or a new module, and updating the frontend to surface the syntax; scope is well above the easy-fix threshold.
